messages:
Aisha: Thinking we run a 4-week microtrial with ~6 design partners to validate onboarding flow, SLA language, and rollback behavior. Thoughts?
Tom: love it. target customers: AI-native startups + one enterprise pilot. timeline?
Aisha: Kickoff week of Apr 25; two 2-week sprints. Recruit window 1 week.
Jun: q — what's the single success metric here? raw adoption or qualitative signal depth?
Aisha: Primary: 80% completion of onboarding tasks within 3 days. Secondary: weekly qualitative score >= 7/10 on stability/clarity.
Priya: require a short weekly eval (10m) + shared prompt set so we can detect regressions quickly.
Tom: also want a canary route: fallback to hosted variant if latency > 500ms at 95th. need rollback playbook.
Aisha: added to acceptance criteria. Incentives: $500 platform credit + early-customer discount for committed DPs.
ProductBot: Reminder: add invite checklist to https://redwood.internal/wiki/dp-microtrial and tag Legal for NDA (allow 3 business days). :robot_face:
Jun: recruiting DM draft below — short + asks for 30m kickoff + consent to anonymous eval collection
Jun: ```Hey — we'd love your help shaping Redwood's private deployment onboarding. 4-week microtrial: 30m kickoff, weekly 15m check-ins, consent to collect config + anonymized logs for diagnostics. $500 credit + early-customer perks. Interested? Reply and we’ll schedule.```
Priya: looks good. add link to Quickstart and include a sample prompt set (3 examples).
Aisha: I'll own outreach list. @Tom can you own rollout policy + tech checklist?
Tom: assigned. I'll post the small-ops rollout checklist in #eng-infra by EOD.
Jun: who owns feedback rubric? I can draft one but need product review.
Aisha: Jun draft rubric; Priya + Tom to review by Tuesday. Keep rubric focused on onboarding clarity, time-to-first-success, and stability notes.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Aisha: scope guard — no model or infra feature work during microtrial. Any feature asks get captured as backlog items and prioritized later.
Tom: noted. creating shared doc now: https://redwood.internal/s/dp-microtrial-2026
Aisha: thanks all. next sync Wed 10am PT. :calendar: ProductBot: Meeting created: dp-microtrial kickoff — Wed 10:00 PT. Attendees: Aisha, Tom, Jun, Priya.
